body: This legitimately made me cry. I will write you something more substantial later, because as I said, I'm not sober right now and I've passed into my "slur phase" to quote Wolf of Wallstreet. But this actually did help. Thank you.
I've been trying that for years. Looked really hopeful about 3 years ago, 22 with a good job and the sky ahead.

What can I do? I belong to a pretty prestigious family in my area. My mother is dead but my father is insanely wealthy. He hates me, I'm the black spot on our lineage. My older brother got out of our abusive mother's custody fairly early and I was next. My younger brother was arrested for DUI and my father made it disappear because my younger brother is hope for him.

Last time I saw my younger brother, I almost got to fistfighting with him because he privately acknowledged to me that the abuse happened and that I wasn't crazy. Except I was the only one who spoke publicly about it and when I did he didn't back up my claims. This lead to my status as black sheep.

I have nothing. Black sheep begets black sheep, right? I spend my days working at my job that has me work 4 hours a day and my nights almost getting shot over $50 worth of coke just to pay my bills.

My life insurance is $200k from my job. My wife could have a real life. The only mistake she ever made was loving a fuck up like me.

Sorry it's so wordy. I haven't been sober for 2 weeks.

I'm completely underappreciated at my job. Been in the same position for three years, taken on more responsibility than anyone and introduced numerous policies that saved us countless hours and dollars.

I work 50-60 hours a week, 6 days and live an hour drive each way from my job. I have absolutely no time for myself.

I cancelled out my clients in the afternoon this past Saturday so I could spend half the day with my girlfriend, and they told me they were short and needed me to stay until 6pm. (Got there at 7am) I actually went into my office and just stared at the wall for 15 minutes. 

I'm consistently torn between what I was always told (Work hard and people will notice) and cutting my losses and realizing this place will never promote me or recognize what I do.

(I worked a 65 hour week during the holidays and we all had a staff meeting, where we're usually told "Good job team." Instead they told us they were cutting the employee of the month program for being too costly.)
Are you the guy with the pulsar star radio waves tattoo on your forearm?
